## Summary

Describe the user-visible behavior, motivation, and trust-boundary impact. Use only synthetic examples.

## Validation

List commands run and outcomes.

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests cover the change, or the reason tests are not applicable is stated.
- [ ] Database changes include an Alembic migration and a tested round trip, or are not applicable.
- [ ] API behavior and `docs/api.md` are updated, or are not applicable.
- [ ] `docs/openapi.json` was regenerated and has no unexplained drift, or is not applicable.
- [ ] UI changes include appropriate screenshots from synthetic data, or explain why none are needed.
- [ ] Keyboard, focus, labels/status, contrast, mobile layout, and overflow were checked, or are not applicable.
- [ ] Security/privacy boundaries were reviewed; no secrets, real data, raw prompts, or sensitive logs are included.
- [ ] AI claims distinguish deterministic and hosted behavior, do not call confidence calibrated accuracy, and preserve human approval.
- [ ] No claim implies autonomous remediation, confirmed diagnosis, response delivery, tenant isolation, compliance, or production readiness.
- [ ] Generated/fixture data is synthetic, deterministic, validated, and checksum changes are explained.
- [ ] Current README/docs/changelog are updated; the historical implementation plan is not used as current authority.
- [ ] Commits are concise, conventional, and scoped.
